headline: OpenAI’s Browser Could Be Hijacked to Spam Your WhatsApp Contacts
context: Researchers at security firm Zenity found more than a dozen flaws in AI browsers—and managed to get OpenAI’s Atlas to make an unauthorized Amazon purchase.
